duration.recordedNote: Recorded time is for information only; it is not an approved working time.

meeting.title: Meeting report
meeting.intro: Filled in after each meeting, for that mentee. Once sent, it is added to your daily report and weekly summary.

MEETING.title: Meeting details
MEETING.hint: Filled in from the calendar; correct it if needed.

TOPIC.title: Topic and purpose
TOPIC.hint: What the mentee brought to this meeting

DETAILS.title: What you discussed
DETAILS.hint: What did you talk about, and how did it go?

SKILLS.title: Skills you used
SKILLS.hint: Which skills did you use as a mentor in this meeting?

OUTCOMES.title: Outcomes and next steps
OUTCOMES.hint: The meeting's concrete result and who does what

EVALUATION.title: Evaluation
EVALUATION.hint: Your own observation; the mentee does not see it.

meeting.sectionMissing: This section has required fields left empty.
meeting.topicsLabel: Meeting topic (pick as many as fit)
meeting.menteeNeed: What did the mentee need? Which question or problem did they bring?
meeting.discussion: What did you talk about? Walk through it step by step.
meeting.approach: Which method or approach did you use, and why?
meeting.skillExample: Give an example of how you used one skill
meeting.outcome: What came out of the meeting?
meeting.followUpHint: Added to the calendar as a suggestion; the mentee confirms.
meeting.nextTime: What would you do differently next time?
meeting.support: Is there something the coordinator should help with?
meeting.supportHint: If you choose "Yes", the coordinator contacts you separately; you don't need to write the details here.
meeting.privacy: Do not write sensitive details such as the mentee's health, family or finances. The coordinator sees the report.
meeting.tip: Fill in the report right after the meeting, the same day at the latest. Be concrete: "we rewrote the project section of the CV together" rather than "I helped".
meeting.sentNote: Sent · {time}. The report is locked; you can still tick off action steps.
meeting.saveFailed: The report could not be saved.
meeting.sendFailed: The report could not be sent.
meeting.notFound: This meeting's report could not be found.
meeting.missingSummary: The report was not sent. Sections with required fields left empty: {sections}

summary.recordedNote: Calculated from meeting and activity records. It is not an approved official working time and does not replace the İŞKUR timesheet.

skills.title: Skills you used this week
skills.subtitle: Calculated from your choices in the meeting reports ({count} meetings)
skills.empty: No skills were chosen in this week's meeting reports.

outcomes.title: Meeting outcomes
outcomes.subtitle: Per mentee, from the meeting reports

evaluation.title: Weekly reflection
evaluation.subtitle: Don't repeat your daily reports; describe the week as a whole.
evaluation.needsObserved: 1. Which student needs did you notice this week?
evaluation.growth: 2. How did you grow as a mentor this week?
evaluation.nextWeekPlan: 3. What do you plan to do next week?

status.title: Weekly summary
status.late: The deadline has passed; you can still send it.
status.inReview: You can't edit it while the coordinator reviews it. It is approved automatically if there is no answer within 7 days.
status.approved: Your weekly summary was approved, and so were the reports under it.

block.notOpen: The weekly summary can be sent from {opensAt}.
block.meetingReports: First send all of this week's meeting reports.

footer.note: The preview and the PDF show what the coordinator will see
footer.submit: Send the weekly summary to the coordinator

weekly.saveFailed: The draft could not be saved.
weekly.submitted: The weekly summary was sent to the coordinator.
weekly.submitFailed: The weekly summary could not be sent.

preview.title: Weekly activity summary
preview.printHint: In the print window, choose “Save as PDF” as the destination.

shell.weekFailed: The week could not be loaded.

daily.activitiesHint: Meetings come from the calendar; you add your other work.
daily.noActivities: No activities for this day yet.
daily.addActivity: + Add an activity outside meetings (resources, messages, events…)
daily.evaluationHint: Describe your day in your own words.

daily.challenge: 2. What was a challenge today, and how did you handle it?
daily.skills: 3. Which skills did you use most today?

daily.learned: 4. What did you learn as a mentor today?
daily.tomorrowPlan: 5. What is your plan for tomorrow?
daily.privacy: Do not write mentees' personal or sensitive details. Share general observations.
daily.weekNote: Your weekly summary is ready on Friday evening.

activity.invalid: Enter a title and a length between 1 and 720 minutes.
